items.question: Trong câu ""Clicking Add sends no request at all" or "it sends a request and gets a 500 back" is evidence that tells the team exactly where to look.", từ "evidence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Clicking Add sends no request at all" or "it sends a request and gets a 500 back" is evidence that tells the team exactly where to look.", what does "evidence" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: facts that show something is true
items.explanation: evidence /ˈev.ɪ.dəns/ (danh từ): bằng chứng. "Evidence" là danh từ không đếm được: nói "a piece of evidence", không nói "an evidence". Trong bug report, bằng chứng là request, status và body.
items.explanationEn: evidence /ˈev.ɪ.dəns/ (noun): facts that show something is true. "Evidence" is uncountable: say "a piece of evidence", not "an evidence". In a bug report the evidence is the request, status and body.

items.question: Trong câu "So either open the Network tab before you click, or reload the page to capture everything from the start.", từ "capture" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "So either open the Network tab before you click, or reload the page to capture everything from the start.", what does "capture" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to catch and hold a person or animal
to record so it can be seen later
items.explanation: capture /ˈkæp.tʃər/ (động từ): ghi lại, thu lại. Hay gặp: "capture traffic", "capture a screenshot". Nghĩa gốc là bắt giữ.
items.explanationEn: capture /ˈkæp.tʃər/ (verb): to record so it can be seen later. Common: "capture traffic", "capture a screenshot". The original sense is to catch and hold.

items.question: Trong câu "If you cannot see it, look behind the `>>` overflow arrow.", từ "overflow" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you cannot see it, look behind the `>>` overflow arrow.", what does "overflow" (noun) mean?
options: phần bị tràn, không đủ chỗ hiển thị
optionsEn: the extra items that do not fit in the visible space
items.explanation: overflow /ˈəʊ.və.fləʊ/ (danh từ): phần bị tràn, không đủ chỗ hiển thị. "Overflow menu" là menu chứa các mục không vừa chỗ (thường là >> hoặc ⋮).
items.explanationEn: overflow /ˈəʊ.və.fləʊ/ (noun): the extra items that do not fit in the visible space. An "overflow menu" holds the items that do not fit (often >> or ⋮).

items.question: Trong câu "A status bar at the bottom sums it up, for example `42 requests | 1.1 MB transferred`.", từ "sum up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A status bar at the bottom sums it up, for example `42 requests | 1.1 MB transferred`.", what does "sum up" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to give a short summary of
items.explanation: sum up /sʌm ʌp/ (cụm từ): tóm tắt, tổng kết. "To sum up" cũng dùng để mở đầu phần kết luận: "To sum up, ...".
items.explanationEn: sum up /sʌm ʌp/ (phrase): to give a short summary of. "To sum up" also opens a conclusion: "To sum up, ...".

items.question: Trong câu "The text box next to it narrows things further.", từ "narrow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The text box next to it narrows things further.", what does "narrow" (verb) mean?
options: làm cho hẹp về chiều rộng vật lý
optionsEn: to make a set of results smaller
items.explanation: narrow /ˈnær.əʊ/ (động từ): thu hẹp (phạm vi). "Narrow down" = thu hẹp dần: "narrow down the cause of a bug".
items.explanationEn: narrow /ˈnær.əʊ/ (verb): to make a set of results smaller. "Narrow down" means to reduce step by step: "narrow down the cause of a bug".

items.question: Trong câu "Now `todos` as GET (load the list) and `todos` as POST (add one) are no longer confusing.", từ "confusing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Now `todos` as GET (load the list) and `todos` as POST (add one) are no longer confusing.", what does "confusing" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: hard to understand or tell apart
items.explanation: confusing /kənˈfjuː.zɪŋ/ (tính từ): gây nhầm lẫn, khó hiểu. Phân biệt: "confusing" (thứ gây nhầm lẫn) và "confused" (người bị nhầm lẫn).
items.explanationEn: confusing /kənˈfjuː.zɪŋ/ (adjective): hard to understand or tell apart. Compare: "confusing" (the thing) and "confused" (the person who feels it).

items.question: Trong câu "With Fetch/XHR and Method on, the Network tab becomes a live view of the API contract from fs-01: one row per endpoint call, in the order the user triggered them.", từ "trigger" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With Fetch/XHR and Method on, the Network tab becomes a live view of the API contract from fs-01: one row per endpoint call, in the order the user triggered them.", what does "trigger" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to pull the trigger of a gun
items.explanation: trigger /ˈtrɪɡ.ər/ (động từ): kích hoạt, gây ra. Hay gặp: "trigger an event", "trigger a request"; danh từ "trigger" là cò súng hoặc điều kiện kích hoạt.
items.explanationEn: trigger /ˈtrɪɡ.ər/ (verb): to cause something to start. Common: "trigger an event", "trigger a request"; the noun is a gun's trigger or a starting condition.

items.question: Trong câu "With Fetch/XHR and Method on, the Network tab becomes a live view of the API contract from fs-01: one row per endpoint call, in the order the user triggered them.", từ "contract" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With Fetch/XHR and Method on, the Network tab becomes a live view of the API contract from fs-01: one row per endpoint call, in the order the user triggered them.", what does "contract" (noun) mean?
options: hợp đồng pháp lý giữa hai bên
bản thỏa thuận kỹ thuật (API contract)
optionsEn: an agreed description of requests and responses
items.explanation: contract /ˈkɒn.trækt/ (danh từ): bản thỏa thuận kỹ thuật (API contract). "API contract" mô tả endpoint, method, body và status mà FE và BE cùng cam kết.
items.explanationEn: contract /ˈkɒn.trækt/ (noun): an agreed description of requests and responses. An "API contract" lists the endpoints, methods, bodies and statuses that FE and BE both commit to.

items.question: Trong câu "You will see dozens of rows: in development Vite serves every source file (`main.jsx`, `App.jsx`, `api.js`, React itself) as a separate request.", từ "serve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You will see dozens of rows: in development Vite serves every source file (`main.jsx`, `App.jsx`, `api.js`, React itself) as a separate request.", what does "serve" (verb) mean?
options: cung cấp, phục vụ (file cho trình duyệt)
optionsEn: to deliver files to a browser
items.explanation: serve /sɜːv/ (động từ): cung cấp, phục vụ (file cho trình duyệt). Từ này là gốc của "server": thứ phục vụ file và dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: serve /sɜːv/ (verb): to deliver files to a browser. This is the root of "server": the thing that serves files and data.

items.question: Trong câu "Bytes transferred, headers included", từ "transfer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bytes transferred, headers included", what does "transfer" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to move data from one place to another
items.explanation: transfer /trænsˈfɜːr/ (động từ): truyền, chuyển (dữ liệu). "Transferred" trong Network là số byte thực sự đi qua mạng, gồm cả header.
items.explanationEn: transfer /trænsˈfɜːr/ (verb): to move data from one place to another. "Transferred" in Network is the bytes that actually crossed the network, headers included.

items.question: Trong câu "The Method column (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) is hidden by default.", từ "by default" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Method column (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) is hidden by default.", what does "by default" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by default /baɪ dɪˈfɔːlt/ (cụm từ): theo mặc định. "Default" còn nghĩa là vỡ nợ (default on a loan).
items.explanationEn: by default /baɪ dɪˈfɔːlt/ (phrase): unless you change it. "Default" can also mean failing to pay a debt (default on a loan).

items.question: Trong câu "A details pane opens with several tabs.", từ "pane" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A details pane opens with several tabs.", what does "pane" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a sheet of glass in a window
a section of a window or screen
items.explanation: pane /peɪn/ (danh từ): khung, ô (trong giao diện). Đừng nhầm với "pain" (nỗi đau), phát âm giống nhau.
items.explanationEn: pane /peɪn/ (noun): a section of a window or screen. Do not confuse it with "pain", which sounds the same.

items.question: Trong câu "The browser only talks to Vite; the proxy that forwards `/api` to Express is invisible from here.", từ "invisible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser only talks to Vite; the proxy that forwards `/api` to Express is invisible from here.", what does "invisible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: invisible /ɪnˈvɪz.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): vô hình, không nhìn thấy. Trái nghĩa: visible. "Invisible to the user" = người dùng không thấy.
items.explanationEn: invisible /ɪnˈvɪz.ə.bəl/ (adjective): not able to be seen. Opposite: visible. "Invisible to the user" means the user cannot see it.

items.question: Trong câu "The browser only talks to Vite; the proxy that forwards `/api` to Express is invisible from here.", từ "forward" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser only talks to Vite; the proxy that forwards `/api` to Express is invisible from here.", what does "forward" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to pass something on to another place
items.explanation: forward /ˈfɔː.wəd/ (động từ): chuyển tiếp. Hay gặp: "forward an email", "forward a request", "port forwarding".
items.explanationEn: forward /ˈfɔː.wəd/ (verb): to pass something on to another place. Common: "forward an email", "forward a request", "port forwarding".

items.question: Trong câu "Click a later request such as `todos` and you will see the browser attaching that cookie automatically.", từ "attach" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Click a later request such as `todos` and you will see the browser attaching that cookie automatically.", what does "attach" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to add something so it goes along with another thing
items.explanation: attach /əˈtætʃ/ (động từ): gắn kèm. "Attach a file to a ticket" = đính kèm file vào ticket; danh từ: attachment.
items.explanationEn: attach /əˈtætʃ/ (verb): to add something so it goes along with another thing. "Attach a file to a ticket"; the noun is attachment.

items.question: Trong câu "Where the cookie is stored, and what `HttpOnly` means in practice, is the subject of fs-11.", từ "in practice" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Where the cookie is stored, and what `HttpOnly` means in practice, is the subject of fs-11.", what does "in practice" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in practice /ɪn ˈpræk.tɪs/ (cụm từ): trên thực tế. Thường đối lập với "in theory" (trên lý thuyết).
items.explanationEn: in practice /ɪn ˈpræk.tɪs/ (phrase): in real use. Often contrasted with "in theory".

items.question: Trong câu "the response JSON as an expandable tree.", từ "expandable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the response JSON as an expandable tree.", what does "expandable" (adjective) mean?
options: có thể mở rộng ra (để xem chi tiết)
có thể nâng cấp phần cứng
optionsEn: able to be opened to show more detail
items.explanation: expandable /ɪkˈspæn.də.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể mở rộng ra (để xem chi tiết). Trái nghĩa trong giao diện: collapsible / collapsed (thu gọn).
items.explanationEn: expandable /ɪkˈspæn.də.bəl/ (adjective): able to be opened to show more detail. UI opposite: collapsible / collapsed.

items.question: Trong câu "Login and sign-up wait noticeably longer than other calls, because hashing a password with bcrypt is deliberately slow.", từ "noticeably" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Login and sign-up wait noticeably longer than other calls, because hashing a password with bcrypt is deliberately slow.", what does "noticeably" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: in a way that is easy to see
items.explanation: noticeably /ˈnəʊ.tɪ.sə.bli/ (trạng từ): một cách rõ rệt. Gốc: notice (nhận thấy).
items.explanationEn: noticeably /ˈnəʊ.tɪ.sə.bli/ (adverb): in a way that is easy to see. From notice (to see or become aware of).

items.question: Trong câu "Login and sign-up wait noticeably longer than other calls, because hashing a password with bcrypt is deliberately slow.", từ "deliberately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Login and sign-up wait noticeably longer than other calls, because hashing a password with bcrypt is deliberately slow.", what does "deliberately" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách thận trọng, chậm rãi
một cách cố ý, có chủ đích
items.explanation: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (trạng từ): một cách cố ý, có chủ đích. Tính từ "deliberate" còn có nghĩa chậm rãi, cẩn trọng. Bcrypt chậm có chủ đích để chống đoán mật khẩu.
items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (adverb): on purpose. The adjective "deliberate" can also mean slow and careful. Bcrypt is slow on purpose to resist password guessing.

items.question: Trong câu "`main.jsx` wraps the app in React `<StrictMode>`, which in development runs every effect twice on purpose to expose mistakes.", từ "expose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (động từ): làm lộ ra, phơi bày. Hay gặp: "expose a bug", "expose data" (làm lộ dữ liệu, nghĩa tiêu cực).
items.explanationEn: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (verb): to make something hidden visible. Common: "expose a bug", "expose data" (a negative sense: leak).

items.question: Trong câu "`main.jsx` wraps the app in React `<StrictMode>`, which in development runs every effect twice on purpose to expose mistakes.", từ "on purpose" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "`main.jsx` wraps the app in React `<StrictMode>`, which in development runs every effect twice on purpose to expose mistakes.", what does "on purpose" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on purpose /ɒn ˈpɜː.pəs/ (cụm từ): cố ý. Trái nghĩa: by accident. Đồng nghĩa: deliberately, intentionally.
items.explanationEn: on purpose /ɒn ˈpɜː.pəs/ (phrase): intentionally. Opposite: by accident. Synonyms: deliberately, intentionally.

items.question: Trong câu "Here the 401 is the designed answer to "am I logged in?" and the app correctly shows the login form.", từ "designed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Here the 401 is the designed answer to "am I logged in?" and the app correctly shows the login form.", what does "designed" (adjective) mean?
options: được thiết kế sẵn, có chủ đích
items.explanation: designed /dɪˈzaɪnd/ (tính từ): được thiết kế sẵn, có chủ đích. "Working as designed" = hoạt động đúng thiết kế, không phải bug.
items.explanationEn: designed /dɪˈzaɪnd/ (adjective): planned to happen that way. "Working as designed" means it behaves as planned, not a bug.

items.question: Trong câu "This one diagram removes most "FE says BE, BE says FE" ping-pong.", từ "ping-pong" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This one diagram removes most "FE says BE, BE says FE" ping-pong.", what does "ping-pong" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: passing a problem back and forth
items.explanation: ping-pong /ˈpɪŋ.pɒŋ/ (danh từ): sự đùn đẩy qua lại. Nghĩa đen là bóng bàn; trong công việc là việc đẩy ticket qua lại giữa các team.
items.explanationEn: ping-pong /ˈpɪŋ.pɒŋ/ (noun): passing a problem back and forth. Literally table tennis; at work, bouncing a ticket between teams.

items.question: Trong câu "Attach the request, its status and its body, and the ticket lands on the right desk the first time.", từ "land" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Attach the request, its status and its body, and the ticket lands on the right desk the first time.", what does "land" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: land /lænd/ (động từ): đến được, rơi vào (đúng chỗ). Nghĩa gốc là hạ cánh; "land a feature" còn nghĩa là đưa tính năng lên thành công.
items.explanationEn: land /lænd/ (verb): to arrive at a place. The original sense is a plane landing; "land a feature" means to ship it.

items.question: Trong câu "One environment trap: if the Express terminal is stopped, Vite's proxy cannot reach port 4000 and the browser gets a 500 with an empty body.", từ "trap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One environment trap: if the Express terminal is stopped, Vite's proxy cannot reach port 4000 and the browser gets a 500 with an empty body.", what does "trap" (noun) mean?
options: cái bẫy, chỗ dễ mắc sai
optionsEn: a hidden problem that easily catches you out
items.explanation: trap /træp/ (danh từ): cái bẫy, chỗ dễ mắc sai. Hay gặp: "fall into a trap" (mắc bẫy).
items.explanationEn: trap /træp/ (noun): a hidden problem that easily catches you out. Common: "fall into a trap".

items.question: Trong câu "On a fast laptop, loading states flash by and failures never happen.", từ "flash by" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On a fast laptop, loading states flash by and failures never happen.", what does "flash by" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to stay on screen a long time
items.explanation: flash by /flæʃ baɪ/ (cụm từ): lướt qua rất nhanh. "Flash" là tia chớp; "flash by" là trôi qua nhanh như chớp.
items.explanationEn: flash by /flæʃ baɪ/ (phrase): to pass very quickly. A "flash" is a sudden light; to "flash by" is to pass in an instant.

items.question: Trong câu "Log in: the button shows `Please wait…` and is disabled, so it cannot be double-submitted.", từ "disabled" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Log in: the button shows `Please wait…` and is disabled, so it cannot be double-submitted.", what does "disabled" (adjective) mean?
options: bị vô hiệu hóa (không bấm được)
optionsEn: switched off so it cannot be used
items.explanation: disabled /dɪˈseɪ.bəld/ (tính từ): bị vô hiệu hóa (không bấm được). Trong giao diện, nút "disabled" thường mờ đi; trái nghĩa: enabled.
items.explanationEn: disabled /dɪˈseɪ.bəld/ (adjective): switched off so it cannot be used. In a UI a disabled button is usually greyed out; opposite: enabled.

items.question: Trong câu "Reload: `Loading…` appears while `GET /api/auth/me` is in flight, then `Loading…` again in the list while `GET /api/todos` loads.", từ "in flight" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reload: `Loading…` appears while `GET /api/auth/me` is in flight, then `Loading…` again in the list while `GET /api/todos` loads.", what does "in flight" (phrase) mean?
options: đang được xử lý, chưa có phản hồi
items.explanation: in flight /ɪn flaɪt/ (cụm từ): đang được xử lý, chưa có phản hồi. "In-flight request" = request đã gửi đi và đang chờ response.
items.explanationEn: in flight /ɪn flaɪt/ (phrase): sent but not yet answered. An "in-flight request" has been sent and is waiting for its response.

items.question: Trong câu "That is a real finding: a missing requirement ("Add is disabled while saving").", từ "finding" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

options: phát hiện (khi kiểm thử, kiểm toán)
optionsEn: something discovered during testing or review
items.explanation: finding /ˈfaɪn.dɪŋ/ (danh từ): phát hiện (khi kiểm thử, kiểm toán). Hay dùng ở số nhiều: "audit findings", "test findings".
items.explanationEn: finding /ˈfaɪn.dɪŋ/ (noun): something discovered during testing or review. Often plural: "audit findings", "test findings".

items.question: Trong câu "It is technically correct and unhelpful to a user, which is exactly the kind of message a BA should specify.", từ "specify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is technically correct and unhelpful to a user, which is exactly the kind of message a BA should specify.", what does "specify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: specify /ˈspes.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): nêu rõ, đặc tả. Danh từ: specification (spec) = bản đặc tả.
items.explanationEn: specify /ˈspes.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to state clearly and exactly. Noun: specification (spec).

items.question: Trong câu "Now block `me` instead and reload: the login form appears although your cookie is valid, so an outage looks like a logout.", từ "outage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Now block `me` instead and reload: the login form appears although your cookie is valid, so an outage looks like a logout.", what does "outage" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a period when a service is not working
items.explanation: outage /ˈaʊ.tɪdʒ/ (danh từ): sự cố ngừng hoạt động. Hay gặp: "a service outage", "a partial outage".
items.explanationEn: outage /ˈaʊ.tɪdʒ/ (noun): a period when a service is not working. Common: "a service outage", "a partial outage".

items.question: Trong câu "The row shows `(blocked:devtools)`, and the app shows `Failed to fetch` and `Nothing here yet.`: an error plus a misleading empty state.", từ "misleading" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The row shows `(blocked:devtools)`, and the app shows `Failed to fetch` and `Nothing here yet.`: an error plus a misleading empty state.", what does "misleading" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: guiding someone the wrong way on a road
